route: Autorisation d'embauchage et permis de travail

permit.applies: The employer in Monaco, through its employer area on MonGuichet.mc or on paper to the Employment Office; for a non-European candidate without a work-authorising French residence permit, by contacting the Head of the Employment Department.
permit.first: The job offer reported to the Employment Office, which within four clear days sends any priority candidates (Monegasques and their families, Monaco residents, then neighbouring communes' residents already employed in Monaco); the employer gives reasoned feedback on each before proposing its own candidate.

fees.what: Stamp duty on the application for hiring authorisation and work permit (and on each renewal or modification of the contract)

sources.title: Gouvernement Princier de Monaco, Mon Entreprise: How to recruit staff
sources.said: Any job offer must be reported to the Employment Office who will then forward the suitable candidates who have priority status in terms of employment in Monaco. … Within 4 clear days of submitting your job offer , the Employment Office will send you, where applicable, the priority candidates who may be suitable for the position. … You must provide reasoned feedback on all applications suggested by the Employment Office before submitting your candidate. … For all recruitment requests from candidates of non-European nationality who do not have a residence permit authorising them to work issued by the Prefecture of the Alpes-Maritimes, and whom you would like to see settle in the Principality within the framework of the job offered, please contact the Head of the Employment Department directly … Once the proposed application has been validated by the Employment Office, you must complete the recruitment application from your employer area on Monguichet. … Accompanied by €5 stamp duty, by cheque or cash

sources.title: MonEntreprise (Government of Monaco), How to renew or modify a contract of employment
sources.said: The application should then be sent or submitted to the Employment Office accompanied by payment of €5 stamp duty. … Once all the necessary administrative approvals have been obtained, the employee will be issued with a new work permit.

note: The authorisation to hire comes after the Employment Office's priority step; the work permit follows it. A non-European performer also needs the French long-stay visa and Monaco residence, not modelled here. The work permit follows the contract of employment: renewing or modifying the contract brings a new work permit (MonEntreprise); no term of its own is stated.
